points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and batch processing efficiency for large-scale document QA workflows.
\item Introduced batched query extraction pipeline, reducing LLM API calls by ~80% per query batch and enabling faster, cost-effective production inference at Apple scale.
\item Developed ML-based anomaly detection system using TensorFlow, processing millions of MFA transactions daily and reducing redundant verification prompts by 25%.
\item Optimized production ML pipeline by eliminating redundant processing steps, reducing inference time from 7 minutes to 3 minutes for high-throughput batch systems.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable ML solutions using Docker and AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, ECR), ensuring production-ready pipelines handling millions of daily requests.
\item Built end-to-end CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automated ML model retraining and deployment to AWS, ensuring reliable and reproducible releases.
